source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e, folder royaltrouble; routes and dialogue checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

st.t: Travel to Miscellania. You can take a boat from Rellekka. You can also use Fairy Rings to teleport there with the code CIP If you've unlocked them.
Go up the stairs in Miscellania castle and talk to Advisor Ghrim.
s: Has anything been happening in the kingdom recently?
Very well, I'll sort it out.

st.t: Talk to the royal you chose in Throne of Miscellania, in Miscellania castle: Princess Astrid or Prince Brand.
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Gardener Gunnhild outside the castle.
Return to King Vargas in Miscellania castle.
Talk to Queen Sigrid in Etceteria Castle.
Talk to Matilda in the south of Etceteria Castle.
Return to Queen Sigrid in Etceteria Castle.

Go to the bank in the north of Etceteria and get your combat gear and antipoisons out. Keep about 10 inventory spaces free. Also bring 5 coal. With 30 Mining you can bring a pickaxe instead and mine the coal in the dungeon.
Return to King Vargas in Miscellania castle.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim in Miscellania castle.
s: King Vargas asked me to talk to you.

st.t: Talk to the Sailor on the Miscellania docks.
Return to King Vargas in Miscellania castle to get a scroll.
Go down the ladder south of Miscellania castle.
Talk to Donal in the pub in the dungeon.
s: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!

st.t: Use the mining prop on the crevice in the north west corner of the dungeon.
Enter the crevice in the north west corner of the dungeon.
Take a Pulley Beam.
Use the Pulley Beam on the Broken Scaffold
Take a Pulley Beam.
Take a Beam.
Use a beam on a pulley beam.
Take another Beam.
Use a beam on the long pulley beam.
Use the Longer pulley beam on the Scaffold
Take a Pulley Beam.
Use the pulley beam on the Scaffold
Take a rope from the crate.
Use the rope on the broken scaffold
Take another Beam.
Use a beam on the platform.
Pick up an Engine
Use the Engine on the engine platform
Read the nearby lift manual, then put 5 coal into the engine. If you brought a pickaxe instead of coal, mine 5 coal from the rocks in this room first.
Take a rope from the crate in the lift room.
Take the lift up.
Pick up the plank.
Enter the tunnel.
Use a rope on the rock over the water blocking the path.
Swing over the water on the ropeswing.
Search the fire remains.
Use your plank on each of the 4 rocks in turn to cross them. You keep the plank.
Search the 2nd fire remains further along the path.
Search the 3rd fire remains further along the path.
Search the 4th fire remains further along the path.
Search the 5th fire remains further along the path.
Read the Diary
Enter the crevice at the end of the path.
Talk to Armod.
Prepare to fight the Giant Sea Snake, then follow the passage and enter the crevice at the end of it. It will only use ranged attacks if you stand at a distance. It can poison you.
Kill the Giant Sea Snake.
Pick up the heavy box
Leave the room.
Go up the rope that's appeared.
Talk to Queen Sigrid in Etceteria Castle.
Return to King Vargas to finish the quest.
